approaches.name: Approach 1: Naive Simulation / Brute Force
approaches.intuition: Directly simulate the problem description step-by-step without advanced data structures.
approaches.theory: Provides the baseline verification algorithm before introducing optimizations.
edgeCases: Empty inputs, negative numbers, extreme bounds.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Optimal C++ Algorithm
approaches.intuition: Leverage optimal C++ STL structures (e.g. unordered_map, priority_queue, or two-pointer passes) to minimize runtime complexity.
approaches.theory: Addresses the bottleneck of the naive approach by caching lookups in O(1) or pruning search branches.

timeComplexity.explanation: Single linear pass with amortized O(1) hash map operations.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Stores unique elements in auxiliary hash map.
